question: Which concerts had at least three different singers performing?
reference_sql: SELECT c.concert_Name FROM concert AS c JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3
candidate_sql:
SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
FROM concert AS c
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3;
evaluation_evidence: Candidate results differ from the reference results.
